summary_en: This study tests zanzalintinib in people with meningioma that has come back or is growing and has not responded to standard therapies. Participants receive zanzalintinib once daily (QD), and the length of treatment is not stated. The study measures efficacy and safety, the specific main outcome is not stated, and it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba zanzalintinib en personas con meningioma recurrente o progresivo que no ha respondido a las terapias estándar. Los participantes reciben zanzalintinib una vez al día (QD), y la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la eficacia y la seguridad, el resultado principal específico no se indica, y es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Histologically confirmed WHO grade 1, 2, or 3 meningioma
Recurrent or progressive disease after standard therapy, or ineligible for these therapies
At least one prior meningioma-directed radiotherapy course, if not contraindicated
Radiologic progression within the prior 6 months or new lesions, with measurable disease by RANO criteria
Karnofsky performance status of at least 60%, with adequate organ and marrow function
not_for: Extracranial lesions invading major blood vessels such as the aorta or inferior vena cava
Systemic anticancer therapy within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives before treatment, whichever is shorter
Uncontrolled significant illness, such as uncontrolled hypertension, high perforation or fistula risk, or significant bleeding
